infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ShieldID uses your camera to scan photos for your identity fingerprint.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ShieldID accesses your photos to build your identity fingerprint and detect stolen images.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: ShieldID sends real-time alerts when threats to your identity are detected.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: ShieldID uses Face ID to protect access to your identity data.

ios._ageRatingNote: Age rating (4+, All Ages) is configured in App Store Connect → App Information → Age Rating. It cannot be encoded in app.json — Expo/EAS has no config key for this. See metadata/README.md and SUBMISSIONS.md Section 2a for the exact questionnaire answers.
